description:
The Nazi regime persecuted scientists and drove away brilliant minds, yet several major discoveries emerged from Germany during this dark period. From antibacterial drugs and hormone isolation to electron microscopy and nuclear fission, these breakthroughs shaped modern medicine and technology, though their origins remain deeply complicated by ideology and suffering.
